name.too-long_one: A destination's name can be at most {{count, number}} character.
name.too-long_other: A destination's name can be at most {{count, number}} characters.
name.control-characters: A destination's name can't contain line breaks or other control characters.

key.missing: Pick the category or folder of the download client this destination saves to.
key.missing-folder: Pick the folder of “{{client}}” this destination saves to.
key.missing-category: Pick the category of “{{client}}” this destination saves to.
key.too-long_one: A category or folder can be at most {{count, number}} character.
key.too-long_other: A category or folder can be at most {{count, number}} characters.
key.control-characters: A category or folder can't contain line breaks or other control characters.

label.comma: A label can't contain a comma.
label.comma-in-name: “{{client}}” shows this destination's name as the torrent's label, and a label can't contain a comma. Pick a name without one.

section.source-missing: Pick the release source of each section.
section.name-control-characters: A section's name can't contain line breaks or other control characters.
section.categories-missing: A section needs at least one category of its release source.
section.category-id-invalid: “{{value}}” is not a category id of a release source.
section.source-gone: A release source you picked sections of no longer exists. Reload the page and pick them again.
section.source-switched-off: “{{source}}” is switched off. Switch it on under Integrations to read its sections.

path.category-missing: The client has no category “{{category}}” any more.
path.save-folder-unknown: The client doesn't say which folder this category saves to, so automatic replacement stays off for this destination.
path.path-unknown-consequence: {{reason, message:clause}}, so automatic replacement stays off for this destination.
path.libraries-unknown: The app doesn't know the media library folders yet. Sync a library from the Library page, then look again.
path.outside-libraries: “{{path}}” is outside every media library folder, so automatic replacement stays off for this destination.
path.folder-not-full-path: The app can't use the folder “{{folder}}” of this destination: it isn't a full path in the client.
path.folder-not-full-path-named: The app can't use the folder “{{folder}}” of this destination: it isn't a full path in “{{client}}”.
path.folder-not-listed: The app can't use the folder “{{folder}}” of this destination: the client didn't list it.
path.folder-not-listed-named: The app can't use the folder “{{folder}}” of this destination: “{{client}}” didn't list it.

client.switched-off: “{{client}}” is switched off. Switch it on under Integrations to use it for destinations.
client.type-unavailable: This version of the app can't send downloads to “{{type}}”.
client.gone: The download client of this destination no longer exists.
client.not-picked: Pick the download client this destination belongs to.
client.category-missing: “{{client}}” has no category “{{category}}”. Create it in the client first, or pick one it has.
client.folder-not-offered: “{{client}}” doesn't offer the folder “{{folder}}”. Pick one of the folders it lists.

edited-invalid: The destination being edited isn't a valid id. Reload the page and open it again.
libraries-unmapped: None of the media library folders maps to a folder of the app through its integration's path mappings. Check those mappings under Integrations, then look again.
folder-too-long_one: The folder “{{folder}}” in “{{client}}” is longer than the {{count, number}} character a destination can hold.
folder-too-long_other: The folder “{{folder}}” in “{{client}}” is longer than the {{count, number}} characters a destination can hold.

unplaced.not-in-app: The library “{{library}}” is at “{{path}}” in Jellyfin, which none of its integration's path mappings brings into this app, so the app can't find its folder in “{{client}}”. Check the path mappings of “{{integration}}”.
unplaced.not-covered: “{{client}}” has no folder for the library “{{library}}”: none of its path mappings leads to “{{folder}}”. Add one under Integrations, “{{client}}”, Path mappings (for example /downloads → /media), then look again.
unplaced.ambiguous: “{{client}}”'s path mappings lead to the library “{{library}}” (“{{folder}}”) from different places: “{{first}}” and “{{second}}”. Keep one of those mappings, then look again.
unplaced.unwritable: “{{client}}” has no folder for the library “{{library}}”: {{reason, message}}
unplaced.too-long_one: The folder of the library “{{library}}” in “{{client}}” (“{{folder}}”) is longer than the {{count, number}} character a destination can hold.
unplaced.too-long_other: The folder of the library “{{library}}” in “{{client}}” (“{{folder}}”) is longer than the {{count, number}} characters a destination can hold.
